facts.fact: The World Bank's appraisal document states that Chad created ANATS in 2016 as the government institution in charge of operationalising the civil registry and issuing identity cards; the standing arrangement is undated, so the document's date is used.

systems.tiers: national; the document reports significant deficiencies in civil registration, especially in rural areas

systems.system: ANATS biometric identity cards for nationals and refugees
systems.owner: ANATS, with CNARR and UNHCR for refugees under a memorandum of understanding
systems.tiers: national; 1,623,000 people held a secure ID as of March 2024 per ANATS, and around 200,000 refugees had biometric data taken as of April 2024
a social protection register, which fits none of the typology's classes; hindered by the lack of identification

note: Passages only. The document says nothing on how civil registration offices make their record; the one fact is who holds the civil registry.
